draft_en.subject: An own-label or budget switch position at Comms Express - three neutral-brand numbers
draft_en.body:
Hi Justin,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 7 October 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the switch category at Comms Express, neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS/UKCA: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; 24 x Gigabit + 4 x 10G SFP+, L2+ managed, non-PoE - STC-424XGGM - $127.4; DIN-rail industrial 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP, unmanaged - STI-280GE - $46. Fibre accessories stay with your current suppliers - we do not carry them.

One question: is there an own-label or budget switch position you would consider listing, and which of the three fits it?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
